text.description_html:
AHI SIG272-630 ADA Compliant Restroom Door Bolt with Occupancy Indicator

This ADA Compliant restroom door bolt also has an Occupancy Indicator outside. Normally used on commercial restroom doors where privacy is required by the rooms occupant. Emergency entry from outside using simple allen wrench tool (no key required). All stainless steel construction with a Satin Stainless Steel finish.
For doors with 2-3/4" Backset - How to measure Backset

Stainless Steel doorbolt, extremely resistant to knocks, scratches and abrasion making it an ideal material for industrial and commercial door hardware.

For use on commercial and public restroom doors that require ADA compliant locking inside an occupancy indicator outside. Red indicator shows outside when locked. Fits standard 2-1/8" door prep with a with 2-3/4" Backset.

Specifications for AHI SIG272-630 Stainless Steel Occupancy Indicator Doorbolt

  • Diameter: 2.36" (60 mm)
  • ADA Compliant
  • Fits standard 2-1/8" bore hole
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Backset: 2-3/4" Backset
  • Satin Stainless Steel Finish

Sold as complete set. Inside Thumbturn, outside Occupancy Indicator and Bolt.

** This item is being discontinued. Very limited quantities available.
